name: Berry Overnight Oats
steps: Combine oats, yogurt, milk and chia in a jar.
Top with berries, refrigerate overnight.

name: Spinach & Feta Egg Scramble
steps: Wilt spinach in oil.
Add beaten eggs, stir gently until set.
Fold in feta.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
steps: Toast bread.
Spread peanut butter, top with sliced banana.

name: Tofu Breakfast Burrito
steps: Crumble and brown tofu with diced pepper.
Warm beans.
Fill tortillas with tofu, beans, salsa; roll.

name: Lemon Chicken Quinoa Bowl
steps: Cook quinoa.
Season and grill chicken with lemon and oil.
Chop veg, assemble bowls.

name: Smashed Chickpea Salad Wrap
steps: Mash chickpeas with mayo and diced celery.
Season, wrap with lettuce in tortillas.

name: Turkey Avocado Sandwich
steps: Layer turkey, sliced avocado and tomato on bread.

name: Red Lentil Soup
steps: Saute onion and carrot.
Add lentils, tomatoes, broth, cumin.
Simmer 25 min, blend partially.

name: Sheet-Pan Salmon & Broccoli
steps: Toss broccoli with oil and garlic.
Add salmon, roast at 425F for 15 min.
Finish with lemon.

name: Beef & Veggie Stir-Fry
steps: Cook rice.
Sear sliced steak, remove.
Stir-fry veg with garlic, return beef, add soy sauce.

name: Black Bean & Sweet Potato Tacos
steps: Roast cubed sweet potato with chili powder.
Warm beans.
Fill tortillas, top with avocado and lime.

name: Pasta Primavera
steps: Boil pasta.
Saute garlic, zucchini, tomatoes.
Toss with pasta and parmesan.

name: Coconut Chicken Curry
steps: Brown chicken and onion.
Add curry paste and coconut milk, simmer 20 min.
Stir in spinach; serve over rice.

name: Garlic Shrimp Zucchini Noodles
steps: Spiralize zucchini.
Saute shrimp in butter and garlic.
Toss with zoodles 2 min, add lemon.

name: Hummus & Veggie Sticks
steps: Cut veg into sticks, serve with hummus.

name: Apple & Almonds
steps: Slice apple, serve with almonds.

name: Cottage Cheese & Pineapple Bowl
steps: Top cottage cheese with pineapple.

name: Sheet-Pan Chicken, Potatoes & Green Beans
steps: Heat oven to 425F.
Halve potatoes and cut carrots into coins; toss with 2 tbsp olive oil, salt, pepper and spread on a sheet pan. Roast 15 min.
Toss chicken thighs with remaining oil, minced garlic, paprika, salt and pepper.
Push veggies aside, add chicken to the pan, roast 20 min.
Add green beans for the last 10 min, until chicken reads 175F and beans are tender.
Squeeze lemon over everything and serve.

name: Khao Piak Sen (Lao Chicken Noodle Soup)
steps: Fry the sliced garlic in the oil over medium-low until pale gold, drain; repeat with shallots. Reserve both and the infused oil.
Char/soften the onion, ginger, lemongrass, sliced garlic, lime leaves and cilantro stems in 3 tbsp of the reserved oil in a large pot.

Add the whole chicken and water to cover, season with salt, soy sauce, fish sauce and sugar. Simmer gently until the chicken is cooked through, then pull the chicken out, let it cool, and shred the meat.
Keep simmering the broth with the bones for depth; strain out the aromatics and taste for salt.
Make the noodle dough: whisk 200 g each rice flour and tapioca flour, stir in the boiling water, then knead until smooth and elastic. Rest briefly.
Roll the dough out on a surface dusted with the remaining 20 g each rice and tapioca flour; cut into thick noodles and toss in the extra flour.
Boil the noodles directly in the simmering broth until chewy and the broth thickens slightly from the starch.
Serve the noodles and broth in bowls topped with shredded chicken, scallions, cilantro, fried garlic and shallots, morning glory, with chiles and lime wedges on the side.

name: Weeknight Ground Beef Tacos
steps: Brown the beef with diced onion, breaking it up; drain excess fat.
Stir in chili powder, cumin, a pinch of salt and a splash of water; simmer 5 minutes.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet.
Serve with shredded lettuce, diced tomato, salsa and lime. Keep the spice mild for kids and add hot sauce at the table.

name: Spaghetti with Meat Sauce
steps: Soften finely diced onion and grated carrot in olive oil, then add garlic.
Add the beef and brown it well; stir in tomato paste and cook 2 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes and Italian seasoning; simmer 20 minutes.
Toss with cooked spaghetti. Skip the parmesan for a dairy-free plate. Sauce freezes well.

name: Korean-Style Beef Rice Bowls
steps: Start the rice.
Brown the beef; add grated garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Stir in soy sauce, brown sugar and sesame oil; simmer until glossy, about 3 minutes.
Serve over rice with sliced green onions and cucumber.

name: Beef and Bean Chili
steps: Brown the beef in a large pot; add diced onion, pepper and garlic and cook until soft.
Stir in chili powder and cumin for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, drained beans and broth; simmer 40 minutes, stirring now and then.
Season to taste. Mild as written; add cayenne to individual bowls. Better the next day and freezes well.

name: Baked Meatballs in Marinara
steps: Heat the oven to 425F. Mix beef, eggs, breadcrumbs, grated onion, garlic, seasoning and salt without overworking.
Roll into about 24 balls and bake on a lined sheet for 15 minutes.
Simmer the meatballs in marinara for 10 minutes.
Serve over pasta or in rolls. Check breadcrumb and marinara labels for milk or cheese.

name: Smash Burgers
steps: Divide the beef into 6 loose balls; heat a cast-iron pan until very hot.
Press each ball flat in the pan with a spatula, season, and cook 2 minutes until deeply browned; flip for 30 seconds.
Toast the buns in the pan.
Build with lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles and sauces. Skip cheese for a dairy-free burger and check the bun label.

name: Cottage Pie with Olive Oil Mash
steps: Boil peeled potatoes until tender; mash with olive oil, salt and a little cooking water instead of butter and milk.
Brown the beef with diced onion and carrot; stir in tomato paste, thyme and Worcestershire.
Add broth and simmer 10 minutes until thick; stir in peas.
Spread the filling in a baking dish, top with mash, and bake at 400F for 25 minutes until golden. Assemble a day ahead if you like.

name: Beef and Rice Stuffed Peppers
steps: Cook the rice. Halve the peppers lengthwise and remove the seeds.
Brown the beef with onion and garlic; stir in the rice, half the tomato sauce and the seasoning.
Fill the peppers, set them in a baking dish and spoon the remaining sauce over.
Cover with foil and bake at 375F for 30 minutes.

name: Ground Beef and Broccoli
steps: Start the rice. Whisk soy sauce, honey, cornstarch and 1/2 cup water.
Brown the beef, then add garlic and ginger.
Add broccoli florets and a splash of water; cover and steam 3 minutes.
Pour in the sauce and stir until thickened. Serve over rice.

name: Beef Lettuce Wraps
steps: Brown the beef; add garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Stir in chopped water chestnuts, hoisin and soy sauce; cook 2 minutes.
Spoon into lettuce cups and top with sliced green onions.

name: Chicken Parmesan
steps: Slice the breasts into thin cutlets; dip in beaten egg, then panko mixed with half the parmesan.
Pan-fry in olive oil until golden, about 3 minutes per side.
Top with marinara, mozzarella and the rest of the parmesan; bake at 425F for 10 minutes.
Serve with spaghetti tossed in more sauce.

name: Chicken Fajitas
steps: Slice chicken, peppers and onion into strips; toss the chicken with spices, lime juice and oil.
Sear the chicken in a hot skillet until cooked through; set aside.
Cook the peppers and onion until charred at the edges; return the chicken.
Serve in warm tortillas with sliced avocado and lime.

name: Chicken Alfredo
steps: Season and pan-sear the chicken; rest and slice.
Boil the fettuccine, adding the broccoli for the last 3 minutes.
Melt butter with garlic, add cream and simmer 3 minutes; whisk in parmesan.
Toss pasta, broccoli and chicken in the sauce, loosening with pasta water.

name: Honey Garlic Chicken Thighs
steps: Start the rice. Sear the thighs skin-side down until browned; flip and cook through.
Pour off most of the fat; add garlic, then honey, tamari and vinegar.
Simmer, turning the chicken, until the glaze is sticky.
Serve over rice with steamed green beans.

name: Chicken Tortilla Soup
steps: Soften the onion; add cumin, broth, tomatoes and whole chicken breasts; simmer 20 minutes.
Shred the chicken and return it with beans and corn; simmer 5 minutes and add lime juice.
Bake tortilla strips at 400F until crisp.
Serve topped with tortilla strips and avocado.

name: Chicken Teriyaki Rice Bowls
steps: Start the rice. Whisk soy sauce, sugar, ginger, cornstarch and 1/3 cup water.
Cook bite-size chicken in a hot pan until browned.
Add the sauce and simmer until thick and glossy.
Serve over rice with steamed broccoli and shredded carrot.

name: Buffalo Chicken Wraps
steps: Cook and slice the chicken.
Melt butter into the hot sauce and toss the chicken in it.
Fill tortillas with lettuce, chicken, sliced celery and a drizzle of ranch; roll tightly.

name: Chicken Pot Pie
steps: Poach the chicken in the broth; reserve the broth and dice the chicken.
Cook onion in butter, stir in flour, then whisk in the broth and milk until thick.
Add chicken and vegetables; pour into a pie dish and top with the crust, cutting vents.
Bake at 400F for 30 minutes until golden. Check the crust label; many contain butter.

name: Greek Chicken Sheet Pan
steps: Toss halved potatoes with oil and roast at 425F for 15 minutes.
Add chicken chunks, onion wedges and tomatoes tossed in oil, lemon and oregano; roast 20 minutes more.
Scatter olives and feta over the top before serving.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
steps: Season and grill or pan-sear the chicken; rest and slice.
Toss chopped romaine with dressing and a squeeze of lemon.
Top with chicken, croutons and shaved parmesan.

name: Classic Chicken Noodle Soup
steps: Soften diced onion, carrot and celery in a pot.
Add broth, thyme and the chicken; simmer 20 minutes, then shred the chicken.
Add noodles and cook until tender. Season well with salt and pepper.

name: Chicken and Snap Pea Stir-Fry
steps: Start the rice. Stir-fry sliced chicken in a very hot pan until browned; remove.
Stir-fry snap peas and pepper 2 minutes with garlic.
Return the chicken with soy sauce, oyster sauce and sesame oil; toss and serve over rice.

name: Chicken Quesadillas
steps: Shred the chicken and dice the pepper.
Fill tortillas with cheese, chicken and pepper; fold.
Cook in a dry skillet 2-3 minutes per side until the cheese melts.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa and sour cream.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
steps: Marinate chicken pieces in yogurt and half the garam masala for at least 15 minutes.
Broil or sear the chicken until charred in spots.
Soften onion, garlic and ginger; add the rest of the spice and the tomatoes; simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in cream and the chicken; simmer 5 minutes. Serve over rice. Mild as written.

name: Lemon Herb Roast Chicken
steps: Pat the chicken dry and rub with oil, herbs, salt and lemon zest; stuff with the lemon halves and garlic.
Set it on chopped carrots and onion in a roasting pan.
Roast at 425F for about 70 minutes, until the thigh reaches 165F.
Rest 10 minutes before carving; spoon pan juices over.

name: BBQ Chicken Drumsticks
steps: Season drumsticks with paprika and salt; roast at 425F for 25 minutes alongside oiled sweet potato wedges.
Brush the drumsticks with BBQ sauce and roast 15 minutes more, brushing again halfway.
Check the BBQ sauce label if you need it gluten-free.

name: Pork Carnitas Tacos
steps: Cut the pork into chunks and season with salt, cumin and oregano.
Braise covered with orange and lime juice, onion and garlic at 325F for 2.5 hours until tender.
Shred, then crisp the pork on a sheet pan under the broiler, basting with the juices.
Serve in warm tortillas with cilantro and onion. Freezes well.

name: Garlic Butter Pork Chops
steps: Boil or microwave the potatoes until tender. Pat the chops dry and season.
Sear the chops 4 minutes per side in a hot skillet.
Add butter, garlic and thyme and baste for 1 minute; rest the chops.
Sauté the asparagus and smashed potatoes in the pan butter.

name: Slow Cooker Pulled Pork Sandwiches
steps: Rub the pork with sugar, paprika and salt; slow-cook on low with sliced onion and half the sauce for 8 hours.
Shred and stir in the rest of the sauce.
Toss the coleslaw mix with vinegar and a pinch of salt.
Pile onto buns with slaw. Check the bun label for milk.

name: Ham Fried Rice
steps: Use day-old rice if you have it. Scramble the eggs in oil; set aside.
Brown the ham, then add peas and carrots.
Add the rice and stir-fry until hot and slightly crisp; add soy sauce, eggs and green onions.

name: Sheet-Pan Sausage and Peppers
steps: Toss sliced peppers, onion and halved potatoes with oil and seasoning.
Nestle the sausages among the vegetables.
Roast at 425F for 25 minutes, turning the sausages once. Serve as is or in rolls.

name: Pork Tenderloin with Roasted Apples
steps: Rub the tenderloin with mustard, maple, rosemary and salt; sear on all sides.
Surround with apple wedges, onion and halved sprouts tossed in oil.
Roast at 425F for 18-20 minutes to 145F; rest 5 minutes and slice.

name: Ground Pork Banh Mi Bowls
steps: Start the rice. Quick-pickle julienned carrot and cucumber in vinegar with a pinch of sugar and salt.
Brown the pork with garlic; add fish sauce and sugar and cook until caramelized.
Serve over rice with pickles, cilantro and a drizzle of mayo (sriracha optional).

name: Pork Ramen Noodle Stir-Fry
steps: Cook the noodles without the seasoning packets; drain.
Brown the pork with garlic, then add chopped bok choy until wilted.
Toss in the noodles with soy sauce, hoisin and green onions.

name: Pork Schnitzel
steps: Pound the chops thin; dredge in flour, beaten egg, then panko.
Fry in hot oil 2-3 minutes per side until deep golden; drain.
Serve with boiled potatoes tossed in butter and lemon wedges.

name: Pork and Pineapple Tacos
steps: Slice the pork thin and toss with chili powder, cumin, lime juice and salt.
Sear in a very hot pan in batches; char the pineapple in the same pan.
Chop together and serve in tortillas with onion and cilantro.

name: Ham and Cheddar Quiche
steps: Press the crust into a pie dish and bake at 375F for 10 minutes.
Whisk eggs and milk with salt and pepper.
Layer ham, wilted spinach and cheddar in the crust; pour in the eggs.
Bake 35-40 minutes until just set. Good warm or cold.

name: Sausage and Egg Breakfast Burritos
steps: Brown the sausage; crisp the hash browns in the same pan.
Softly scramble the eggs.
Fill tortillas with sausage, potatoes, eggs, cheese and salsa; roll tightly.
Wrap in foil to freeze; reheat in the oven or microwave.

name: Bacon Carbonara
steps: Crisp chopped bacon in a skillet; keep the fat.
Whisk eggs with parmesan and lots of black pepper.
Toss the hot drained pasta with the bacon off the heat, then stir in the egg mixture, adding pasta water until silky.

name: Pork Chile Verde
steps: Broil tomatillos, poblanos, onion and garlic until charred; blend with cilantro.
Brown cubed pork in batches.
Simmer the pork in the salsa verde and broth with cumin for about 90 minutes until tender.
Serve with rice or tortillas. Poblanos are mild; taste and adjust.

name: Honey Mustard Pork Chops
steps: Start the rice. Sear the seasoned chops 4 minutes per side; set aside.
Whisk mustard, honey and broth into the pan and reduce by half.
Return the chops to coat in the glaze. Serve with steamed green beans and rice.

name: Sweet and Sour Pork
steps: Start the rice. Toss bite-size pork in cornstarch and pan-fry until crisp; set aside.
Stir-fry pepper, onion and pineapple 3 minutes.
Add ketchup, vinegar, sugar and soy sauce; bubble until thick, then toss the pork back in.

name: Split Pea Soup with Ham
steps: Soften the onion, carrot and celery in a large pot.
Add rinsed split peas, the ham hock and broth; simmer about 75 minutes until thick.
Pull the meat off the hock, return it with the diced ham, and season.

name: Ground Pork and Cabbage Stir-Fry
steps: Brown the pork with ginger and garlic.
Add thinly sliced cabbage and shredded carrot; stir-fry until just tender.
Season with soy sauce and sesame oil. Serve as is or over rice.

name: BLT Sandwiches
steps: Bake the bacon on a sheet pan at 400F for 15-18 minutes until crisp.
Toast the bread and spread with mayo.
Layer bacon, lettuce and sliced tomato. Check the bread label for milk.

name: Sausage, White Bean and Kale Soup
steps: Brown the sausage, removed from its casing, with onion and garlic.
Add broth, tomatoes and drained beans; simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in chopped kale until wilted. Season and serve.

name: Pork Lo Mein
steps: Cook the noodles; drain and toss with sesame oil.
Stir-fry thinly sliced pork until browned; remove.
Stir-fry the vegetables, then add noodles, pork, soy and oyster sauce and toss until coated.

name: Beef Enchiladas
steps: Brown the beef with onion and cumin; stir in beans and half a cup of sauce.
Warm the tortillas, fill and roll them, and set seam-side down in a baking dish.
Cover with the remaining sauce and the cheese.
Bake at 375F for 20 minutes until bubbly.

name: Cheeseburger Macaroni
steps: Brown the beef with onion; stir in tomato paste and mustard powder.
Add broth, milk and the dry macaroni; simmer covered, stirring often, about 12 minutes until the pasta is tender.
Stir in the cheddar off the heat until melted.

name: Sloppy Joes
steps: Brown the beef with diced onion and pepper; drain.
Stir in tomato sauce, ketchup, Worcestershire and brown sugar; simmer 10 minutes until thick.
Spoon onto toasted buns. Check the bun label for milk.

name: Classic Meatloaf
steps: Soak the breadcrumbs in milk; mix with beef, eggs, grated onion, Worcestershire and salt.
Shape into a loaf on a lined sheet pan.
Glaze with ketchup mixed with brown sugar.
Bake at 375F for about 55 minutes to 160F; rest 10 minutes. Leftovers make great sandwiches.

name: Beef Lasagna
steps: Brown the beef with onion; stir in the marinara.
Mix ricotta with the egg, half the parmesan and a pinch of salt.
Layer sauce, noodles, ricotta and mozzarella three times, ending with sauce, mozzarella and parmesan.
Cover and bake at 375F for 45 minutes, uncover for 15. Rest 15 minutes before slicing; freezes well.

name: Taco Salad
steps: Brown the beef with chili powder, cumin and a splash of water.
Toss chopped romaine with tomatoes and beans.
Top with warm beef, cheddar, crushed chips, salsa and sour cream.

name: Swedish Meatballs
steps: Mix beef, egg, breadcrumbs, grated onion, allspice and salt; roll into small meatballs and brown them in butter.
Stir flour into the pan fat, whisk in the broth, and simmer until thick.
Add the cream and meatballs; simmer 10 minutes.
Serve over buttered egg noodles.

name: Beef and Potato Hash
steps: Cook diced potatoes in oil, covered, until tender, then uncover to crisp.
Push aside, brown the beef with onion, pepper and paprika, and mix together.
Make wells and crack in the eggs; cover until set.

name: Mongolian Ground Beef Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles, adding the broccoli for the last 2 minutes; drain.
Brown the beef with garlic and ginger.
Add soy sauce, sugar and 1/4 cup water; simmer 2 minutes, then toss with noodles, broccoli and green onions.

name: Ground Beef Stroganoff
steps: Brown the beef, then the sliced mushrooms and onion, in butter.
Stir in flour, then the broth; simmer until thickened.
Off the heat, stir in the sour cream. Serve over egg noodles.

name: Spinach Ricotta Lasagna
steps: Thaw and squeeze the spinach dry; mix with ricotta, egg and half the parmesan.
Layer sauce, noodles, spinach-ricotta and mozzarella three times, finishing with sauce and cheese.
Cover and bake at 375F for 45 minutes, uncover for 15; rest before slicing.

name: Chickpea and Spinach Curry
steps: Start the rice. Soften onion and garlic; toast the curry powder for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, coconut milk and drained chickpeas; simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted. Serve over rice.

name: Black Bean Burgers
steps: Pat the beans dry and roast them at 375F for 10 minutes so they firm up.
Mash with breadcrumbs, egg, corn and spices; shape into 4 patties.
Pan-fry 4 minutes per side until crusty. Serve on buns with avocado and lettuce.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice
steps: Scramble the eggs in oil; set aside.
Stir-fry the vegetables and edamame 3 minutes.
Add the rice and fry until hot; finish with soy sauce, eggs and green onions.

name: Margherita Flatbread Pizzas
steps: Heat the oven to 450F.
Spread sauce on the flatbreads; top with sliced mozzarella and tomato.
Bake 8-10 minutes until bubbling; finish with basil and a drizzle of oil.

name: Mushroom Risotto
steps: Brown sliced mushrooms in half the butter; set aside.
Soften the onion, toast the rice 1 minute, then add the wine.
Add hot broth a ladle at a time, stirring, until creamy and just tender, about 20 minutes.
Stir in the mushrooms, remaining butter and parmesan.

name: Veggie Quesadillas
steps: Sauté the diced pepper and corn until tender.
Fill tortillas with cheese, beans and vegetables; fold.
Cook in a dry skillet until crisp and melted. Serve with salsa.

name: Eggplant Parmesan
steps: Slice the eggplant into rounds; dip in egg, then panko, and bake on oiled sheets at 425F until golden, flipping once.
Layer eggplant, sauce, mozzarella and parmesan in a baking dish.
Bake at 375F for 25 minutes until bubbling.

name: Lentil Bolognese
steps: Soften finely diced onion, carrot and celery in oil; add tomato paste.
Add lentils, tomatoes and broth; simmer 30 minutes until the lentils are tender and the sauce thick.
Toss with spaghetti.

name: Shakshuka
steps: Soften onion, pepper and garlic; add the spices, then the tomatoes, and simmer 10 minutes.
Make wells and crack in the eggs; cover and cook until the whites set.
Top with feta. Serve with bread for dipping.

name: Tofu and Vegetable Stir-Fry
steps: Start the rice. Press the tofu, cube it, toss in cornstarch, and fry until golden.
Stir-fry the vegetables 3 minutes.
Add soy sauce, maple and the tofu; toss until glazed. Serve over rice.

name: Caprese Pasta Salad
steps: Cook the pasta; rinse under cold water.
Toss with halved tomatoes, mozzarella pieces and torn basil.
Dress with oil, balsamic, salt and pepper. Keeps 2 days in the fridge.

name: Roasted Butternut Squash Soup
steps: Roast cubed squash, onion and apple with oil at 425F for 30 minutes.
Simmer with broth and nutmeg for 10 minutes.
Blend until smooth and stir in the coconut milk. Freezes well.

name: Stovetop Mac and Cheese
steps: Cook the macaroni, adding the peas for the last 2 minutes.
Melt butter, whisk in flour and mustard powder, then the milk; simmer until thick.
Stir in the cheddar until smooth and fold in the pasta and peas.

name: Chickpea Greek Salad Pitas
steps: Toss chickpeas, diced cucumber, tomatoes, onion, olives and feta.
Dress with olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt and pepper.
Stuff into warm pitas.

name: Three-Bean Vegetarian Chili
steps: Soften onion and peppers; add diced sweet potato and the spices.
Add tomatoes, drained beans and 1 cup water; simmer 35 minutes until the sweet potato is tender.
Season to taste. Mild as written; better the next day.
